ModMetaData.name: Jawa Faction Slate
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Takes every faction except the campaign's own off the Configure Factions page, so a generated world contains exactly the intended slate.
🔴 THIS MOD MUST LOAD LAST, OR IT SILENTLY DOES HALF ITS JOB. Every operation is a PatchOperationConditional testing that the FactionDef exists, with no <nomatch> - which is deliberate, because a def belonging to a dropped mod would otherwise throw a red error every load. The cost of that choice is that a faction whose mod has NOT LOADED YET is also a silent no-op. Measured 2026-08-20 after a RimSort re-sort put this mod at 184 of 577: 24 of the 48 factions it patches were defined by mods loading after it, so half the slate would have appeared on the Configure Factions page anyway - and a world generates ONCE.
